questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Blastocystis spp.?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Vacuolar and other forms in stool; use stage-qualified labels.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Vacuolar and other forms in stool; use stage-qualified labels. Wet mounts and permanent stained smears at 400–1000×; molecular analysis identifies subtypes.
